## About
More Miles Auto Repair is a neighborhood shop on Quebec St in Commerce City, serving drivers across northeast Denver. We know trusting someone with your car is a big step, so we explain every service step in detail and keep you in the loop the whole way.
Reviewers tend to mention Mario and Ed by name. One customer called them "honest business men," and another said she was listened to and got all of her questions answered with zero judgement. We're rated 4.9 from 41 Google reviews.
Here, every customer is part of the family. If money is tight, tell us. We'll talk through your options and focus on the repairs your car needs.

## Services
- Brake Repair: From routine inspections to bigger replacements, and we'll keep you informed every step of the way.
- Engine Diagnostic Services: Dashboard light on, car stalled, or a strange noise? We use diagnostic equipment to get to the root of it.
- Oil Change Service: Regular oil changes to keep your engine running smoothly and get you back on the road.
- Wheel Alignment: Precise alignment for straighter steering, fewer shakes and vibrations, and longer tire life.
- Suspension Repair: Shocks, struts and full suspension system evaluations.
- Car AC Repair: From cooling issues to condenser problems, so your cabin stays cool on hot days.
- Emissions Systems Repair: Repair work on your vehicle's emissions system.
- Exhaust service and transmission repair: We also handle exhaust work and transmission repair.

## FAQ
Q: What should I do if I have a tight budget for car repairs?
A: Tell us. We'll discuss your options and work with you on a solution, putting your car's essential repairs and maintenance first.

Q: Do you have Spanish-speaking staff?
A: Yes. Our staff speaks Spanish.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What kinds of work do you do?
A: Wheel alignment, engine diagnostics, oil changes and brake repair, plus exhaust service and transmission repair.
